490: The Siruba AA-6 Bag Closing Machine, made in Thailand, is lightweight and easy to handle when cutting the thread and lifting the presser foot. The machine works with two screens, an outlet spout for dust and chips, and two or three bagging spouts. Vibration comes from an eccentric shaft that moves the charcoal to the spout, making packing possible with even more quality. We also produce special models according to each customer's needs.
